name: Keyboard Tab Shortcuts
description: Keybinds to jump between tabs, move them, pin/unpin, duplicate, multi-select, and group.

select-tab-left.description: Activate the tab to the left

select-tab-right.description: Activate the tab to the right

toggle-pin-tab.description: Pin or unpin the current tab

add-selection-left.description: Add the tab to the left to selection

add-selection-right.description: Add the tab to the right to selection

toggle-group-collapsed.description: Collapse the selected tab group or groups
